# Iceberg writer benchmark

This benchmark compares [iceberg-loader](https://github.com/vndvtech/iceberg-loader) with the open-source [dlt](https://github.com/dlt-hub/dlt) Iceberg destination. Both writers load the same Arrow data into Apache Iceberg tables through a Polaris REST Catalog and MinIO object storage.

<!-- MEASURED:BEGIN (generated by gen_docs.py - do not edit) -->
## Measured result

The NYC 311 public API run used a 1 GiB CSV snapshot (1,721,470 rows).

| Writer | Median write time | Median peak RSS |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| iceberg-loader | 3.684 s | 1.36 GiB |
| dlt | 11.361 s | 2.26 GiB |

In this setup, dlt took **3.08×** as long. The timer covers the write call only; see [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md). Full tables for every scenario: [Results](docs/RESULTS.md) - [raw data](docs/data/PUBLIC_API_1G_RAW_2026-10-02.json).
<!-- MEASURED:END -->

## Setup

Install dependencies and start the Polaris and MinIO services:

```sh
uv sync
cd examples && docker compose up -d && cd ..
```

`uv.lock` pins the exact dependency versions, so `uv sync` reproduces the measured environment. The scripts use the credentials in `examples/docker-compose.yml` by default. For custom installations, set the following environment variables:
- `ICEBERG_REST_URI`, `ICEBERG_WAREHOUSE`, `ICEBERG_CREDENTIAL`, `ICEBERG_OAUTH2_SERVER_URI`
- `S3_ENDPOINT`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY`, `S3_SECRET_KEY`, `S3_REGION`, `BENCHMARK_S3_ROOT`

## Run the benchmark

### Public API data
Downloads NYC 311 Service Requests and measures ingestion:
```sh
# 1 GiB reproduction
.venv/bin/python public_api_run.py --sizes-mib 1024 --chunk-mib 256 --repeats 3 --warmups 0

# 10 GB run
.venv/bin/python public_api_run.py --sizes-gb 10 --chunk-mib 256 --repeats 3
```

### Remote storage (Polaris + MinIO)
Uses deterministic Arrow data:
```sh
.venv/bin/python rest_run.py
```

### Local storage (SQLite/Filesystem)
Uses deterministic Arrow data:
```sh
.venv/bin/python run.py
```

## Cleanup

Every repetition uses a unique REST namespace. After each run, scripts drop the table and namespace, delete the corresponding S3 prefix, and remove local pipeline state. The root S3 bucket is not deleted.
